info.title: Watermarking System API
info.description: API for the Watermarking System project. This API allows you to manage organizations, batches, and Allegro authentication. It provides endpoints for creating and managing organizations, uploading and downloading files, and handling Allegro authentication tokens.

offerId.description: Allegro offer ID associated with these images.

images.description: HTTPS URLs of the product images. Provide between 1 and 20 images.

products.description: Products included in the batch. Each product must contain an offer ID and between 1 and 20 HTTPS image URLs.

watermarkConfig.description: Optional JSON configuration for the watermark. The supported properties depend on the watermark processing implementation.
